lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: My life is all back to normal, and it's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: My parties have been flooding with guests,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and even my fiancée decided to give me another chance.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Sure, some people give me a hard time for how I come off in the video,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: but things are way better than they were before.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I told my Father about what you did for me.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You may find that your supplies will be a little more generous than before,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and certain high-ranking officers may be somewhat friendlier than usual.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Consider it my thanks to you.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I look forward to the day we meet again.
